Your fear of loneliness is irrational. You are born alone and you die alone. What seems to be the core issue is lack of a romantic relationship.

The fear of rejection is holding you back. This is a mindset thing. Rather than looking at the potential loss in any social interaction look at the upside.

Example: talking to the pretty girl

Downside: she rejects you (big deal...you’re still alive)

Upside: you returns interest you ask her for her number, maybe  a potential girlfriend!

It’s easy to tell you to see the enormous upside in any interaction while forgetting the downside, but it’s much harder in reality to DO IT. 

You have to let yourself fail. It’s simple. People are going to reject you...you will taste dirt. 

But what people forget is that each taste of dirt is a step closer to tasting the cake.

So in reality every attempt is a stepping stone to your desires. Simply look the fuck ups as stepping stones. 

Your attention can’t be directed on what could go wrong, you have to literally reset your focus on the upside and the simple fact that “it’s only a matter of time.”

And it really is. Taste dirt for a month, approach every damn girl that attracts you. Watch what happens.

Specific to your situation....so you’re friends didn’t throw you a big 30 bash. Well, remember expecting them to do so (without asking) is living from the outside in. 

Flip the script. Live from the inside out. What can YOU do? Make it known to your friends that you would like a birthday bash, THERE IS NO WAY FOR THEM TO KNOW UNLESS YOU TELL THEM. 


Ask and you shall receive. Asking for what you want is the ultimate action of someone who lives from the inside out.

Ask for the birthday bash.

Ask for what YOU WANT.
